paper_title: Searching for axion-like particles with ultra-peripheral heavy-ion collisions
suggested_experiment_name: UPC Pb-Pb ALP search (LHC projection, 1 nb⁻¹)
notes: Paper presents projected sensitivity (1 nb^-1, 10 nb^-1 Pb-Pb UPCs) and recast limits (OPAL, ATLAS, CMS) on ALP-photon coupling 1/Lambda (GeV^-1) for aFFtilde and aBBtilde operators. The coupling is 1/Lambda where g_agamma = 1/Lambda. However, only graphical results in Fig. 4 (log axis ~1e-5 to 1e-3 GeV^-1, mass 5-100 GeV) are given; no numerical table or explicit text values exist to extract reliable (mass, coupling) pairs. Mixed new/recast/projection results. Coupling type is AxionPhoton (ALP-photon). | Vision: Figure 4 left panel: aF̃F coupling, y-axis is 1/Λ (GeV⁻¹) which corresponds to g_aγγ. X-axis is partly log (below 5 GeV) and linear (above 5 GeV). I traced the lower envelope of the exclusion region given by the projected Pb-Pb sensitivity (green solid, 1 nb⁻¹), which is this paper's new result and forms the lowest reachable boundary. The dashed green (10 nb⁻¹) curve goes lower but is a high-luminosity projection. Masses converted from GeV to eV. Confidence reduced because the y-axis is technically 1/Λ rather than the canonical g_aγγ=1/Λ definition (factor differences possible), and the linear x-axis above 5 GeV requires care. | Calibration: No calibration needed | Auto-corrected masses: μeV→eV (×1.00e-06)
